dict.string: Clipx uses Apple Events to capture the frontmost video clip when the global hotkey is pressed.
Clipx needs to read video files stored on your Desktop to index and generate thumbnails for your library.
Clipx needs to read video files stored in Documents to index and generate thumbnails for your library.
Clipx needs to read video files stored in Downloads to index and generate thumbnails for your library.
Clipx connects to your chosen review server and shares your library with paired browsers when you enable Remote.
Clipx reads video files from network volumes so you can clip footage stored on NAS or shared drives.
Clipx reads video files from removable drives so you can clip footage stored on external media.
